messages:
sam_k: Quick final lock for Predict GA — we need explicit agreement on: SLA wording (penalties + exclusions), pricing examples + billing behavior, canary cadence and rollback thresholds, docs gaps (quickstart + quota/overage), and oncall coverage. Goal: ship Fri. Please ACK or flag asap. @leah_c @omar_b @nisha_m

leah_c: SLA: propose p99 <= 300ms for hosted-standard, uptime SLA 99.9% monthly. Add an exceptions section for force-majeure and scheduled maint windows communicated 24h in advance. Penalty = service credit up to 1 month prorated. Draft posted: https://staging.docs/redwood/predict/sla-v2

omar_b: Pricing: token-metered, billed per 1k-token window. Finops wants an example invoice line and a short FAQ on trial credits. Behavior on quota exceed = 429 + X-Quota-Remaining + X-Quota-Reset headers. Will draft examples.

nisha_m: Docs: Quickstart, error-handling, and quota blurb are the GA must-haves. Streaming examples can be marked "preview" and ship after GA. I can finish quickstart tonight. Need the quota wording from Omar for the FAQ blurb.

ops-bot: Infra preflight: capacity headroom OK; canary slot reserved 2024-11-08T09:00Z. Canary plan template: internal -> 1% -> 10% -> 100% with gating. Synthetic smoke scheduled every 5m for canary.

sam_k: Canary gating thresholds suggested: p99 > 400ms OR errors > 0.75% over 10m -> pause and evaluate. If sustained > 15m, trigger automated fallback to quantized-fallback and escalate to #incidents. Agreed?

leah_c: Agree on thresholds but recommend lower p99 threshold for early cohorts (start with 350ms for 1% cohort). Also require model-quality SLI (sample prompt baseline) — if quality drops > 4% vs baseline, pause rollout.

omar_b: Billing/trial: legal requires explicit non-refundable trial-credit language. Proposed copy: "Trial credits are promotional and non-refundable. For disputes contact billing@redwood.ai within 30 days." Will include in FAQ. Legal approval pending.

legal-bot: Reviewing proposed trial wording. Note: if we market "trial" as refundable in any merch, we need different language. Confirm the exact FAQ location so legal can sign off.

nisha_m: Support/oncall: I'll take primary for GA day + next 48h. Need one evening backup (UTC-7). Omar, can you cover evenings for week1? Also we need a one-page runbook for degraded-model fallback with canned customer comms.

omar_b: I can cover evenings Wed-Fri week1. I'll draft the runbook with steps: detect -> automated switch -> post incident -> notify customers (template) -> engage infra.

ops-bot: Runbook placeholder created in staging runbooks. Automated fallback (staging) = route to quantized-v2 -> post summary to #incidents -> create ticket. Manual opt-in to revert.

leah_c: Docs blurb suggestion for quota: "When monthly quota is exceeded, API returns 429 with headers X-Quota-Remaining and X-Quota-Reset. Contact sales to increase quotas or request a one-time overage." Omar please confirm wording.

omar_b: Confirmed. I'll add a short billing example: "Charges: Predict API - 1k-token = $0.012 - Qty 73 => Line total $0.876" and add to billing FAQ.

sam_k: Smoke command for CI/canary to include in docs: ```bash
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/predict -d '{"input":"smoke test"}' | jq '.status, .latency_ms'
``` assert HTTP 200 and status == "ok". We'll run every 5m.

legal-bot: If product confirms final FAQ location I will sign off on the trial-credit wording within 2 hours. Otherwise this remains a hard blocker.

sam_k: Owners: sam_k (launch lead), leah_c (SLA/docs/monitoring), omar_b (pricing/finops/runbook), nisha_m (support/oncall). Hard blocker = legal sign-off on trial/refund language. If legal clears within 2h, we call green and schedule canary per ops-bot. If not, delay GA by 24h.

nisha_m: Thanks — I'll merge quickstart PR after Omar lands billing blurb. Leaving thread open for legal ack. :eyes:
